name: Ladder
long_description: Ladder is an AI personal assistant for in-home sales. It takes notes on the in-person conversation and helps reps close more deals, improve with each pitch, and deliver and generate more leads.
one_liner: AI personal assistant for in-home sales

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
David is the co-founder and CEO of Maive.

He started his career as a manufacturing engineer at Rolls-Royce where he once uncovered quality issues due to missing paperwork that stopped production for a week. After obtaining a Masters in Engineering from UC Berkeley, David spent five years at Dexterity AI, a unicorn robotics startup. He began as a software engineer and ended as a senior manager leading product engineering.

David holds 15 patents spanning robotics and aerospace engineering.

founders.title: Founder/President
founders.founder_bio:
Will is the co-founder and President of Ladder.

Previously, Will was the Machine Learning and Computer Vision tech lead at Dexterity, a unicorn robotics company. Before Dexterity, Will founded his own computer vision and machine learning startup while pursuing a Master’s in Machine Learning at UT Austin. He started his career at Intel as a software engineer on their autonomous driving platform.

At 13, Will founded a business repairing broken Xbox 360’s and selling them on eBay.

launches.title: Ladder: The Personal AI Assistant for Home Services Sales Reps
launches.tagline: Ladder helps home services sales reps be successful
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Will and David, co-founders of Ladder.

**TL;DR:** Ladder is the first AI personal assistant for in-home sales reps. It works for reps instead of monitoring them.

**The problem**\
Home services companies leave millions on the table every year because their reps are on their own in the field. No one is there to listen and help them improve. Most sales AI feels like Big Brother, so reps don't use it.

**The solution**\
Ladder works for reps. Reps love it because it helps them:

* Earn more commission.
* Handle busy work.
* Generate more referrals.

We price based on outcomes, so we only get paid when reps use ladder to sell a project. 

Leading home services companies already trust Ladder across more than $100M in jobs.

**Our ask**\
Do you know someone who runs sales at a home services company? We'd love an intro. Get in touch at [hey@ladderai.com](mailto:hey@ladderai.com).
